tips.text: Replay Break Narmer for the blue Stock crates; beat the boss and extract to keep up to five, worth 10 Stock a run.
Spend the early weeks' Stock on lower-rank items and keep 30 for the week you hit Rank 4.
Clear the side rooms in Prison Break before you board the Bolkor; anything you miss is gone.
In Sneaky Sabotage, sprint past the Deacons; they are slow, and flashbangs work on them.
Backtrack for missed collectibles after the final boss dies; the 15-minute challenge has already counted.
Nobody minds the wait for Aegrit; it is three short weekly runs you would do anyway for Styanax, Afentis and the Archon mods.
